Class KfeLightningOutboundExecutor

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.paymentexecution.adapters.out.execution.KfeLightningOutboundExecutor
All Implemented Interfaces:
KfeRailExecution, ExternalExecutionPort
@Service public class KfeLightningOutboundExecutor extends Object implements KfeRailExecution, ExternalExecutionPort
Executes prepared outbound Lightning payments outside database transactions with claim fencing.
